grammar.pattern: 把 / 被 / 叫 / 让
grammar.purpose: Separate the actor and the affected object
grammar.explanation: 把 introduces a known object that the subject handles: 我把衣服挂好了. 被 introduces the agent of a passive event: 衣服被雨弄湿了; the agent may be omitted with 被. 叫 and 让 can also introduce a passive agent in colloquial speech: 衣服叫雨弄湿了 / 衣服让雨弄湿了. These passive uses require an agent and differ from 叫/让 meaning ask or allow. Do not infer the cause or actor from a bare changed state.

examples.py: wǒ bǎ yī fú guà hǎo le .
examples.en: I have hung up the clothes properly.

examples.py: yī fú bèi yǔ nòng shī le .
examples.en: The clothes were made wet by rain.

examples.zh: 衣服叫雨弄湿了，也可以说衣服让雨弄湿了。
examples.py: yī fú jiào yǔ nòng shī le , yě kě yǐ shuō yī fú ràng yǔ nòng shī le .
examples.en: One can colloquially say the clothes were made wet by rain using either 叫 or 让.

commonMistakes.why: For this agentless passive, use 被. With colloquial passive 叫/让, state the agent.

grammar.pattern: 把 + 已知物 + 处所 / 接收者 / 结果
grammar.explanation: Use a known or specified object, then a predicate describing its placement, transfer or changed state. Placement: 把包裹放在门边 / 放到门边. Transfer: 把这本书交给她. Result or direction: 把绳子解开 / 把箱子搬进去. The action alone in 请把书放 is incomplete here. Negation and modal verbs precede 把: 不要把衣服放地上; 可以把书交给她.

examples.py: qǐng bǎ bāo guǒ fàng zài mén biān .

lines.zh: 你订的包裹到了，放哪里？
lines.py: nǐ dìng de bāo guǒ dào le , fàng nǎ lǐ ?
lines.en: Your ordered parcel has arrived; where should I put it?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 请把包裹放在门边，别放沙发上。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ bāo guǒ fàng zài mén biān , bié fàng shā fā shàng .
lines.en: Please put the parcel by the door, not on the sofa.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 房东说先放这里，房屋地址没错吧？
lines.py: fáng dōng shuō xiān fàng zhè lǐ , fáng wū dì zhǐ méi cuò ba ?
lines.en: The landlord said to leave it here first; the building address is correct, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没错。房租另付，不在这次快递费用里。
lines.py: méi cuò . fáng zū lìng fù , bù zài zhè cì kuài dì fèi yòng lǐ .
lines.en: Correct. Rent is paid separately and is not part of this delivery charge.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 袋子被雨弄湿了，里面的被子呢？
lines.py: dài zi bèi yǔ nòng shī le , lǐ miàn de bèi zi ne ?
lines.en: The bag got wet in the rain; what about the quilt inside?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先把绳子解开看看。绳子很紧，别直接拉。
lines.py: xiān bǎ shéng zi jiě kāi kàn kàn . shéng zi hěn jǐn , bié zhí jiē lā .
lines.en: Untie the cord and check first. It is tight; do not just pull.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我把书交给你，你看衣服。
lines.py: nà wǒ bǎ shū jiāo gěi nǐ , nǐ kàn yī fú .
lines.en: Then I will hand the book to you, and you check the clothes.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，书放到书架上，衣服再分开。
lines.py: hǎo , shū fàng dào shū jià shàng , yī fú zài fēn kāi .
lines.en: Okay; put the book on the bookcase and separate the clothes next.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Open before guessing
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Distinguish the known bag condition from the items still being checked.

lines.zh: 包裹到了，房东让我们先放在门边，房屋地址已经核对。
lines.py: bāo guǒ dào le , fáng dōng ràng wǒ men xiān fàng zài mén biān , fáng wū dì zhǐ yǐ jīng hé duì .
lines.en: The parcel arrived; the landlord asked us to leave it by the door, and the building address has been checked.

lines.zh: 房租单独付，不能把订衣架的费用当房租。
lines.py: fáng zū dān dú fù , bù néng bǎ dìng yī jià de fèi yòng dāng fáng zū .
lines.en: Rent is paid separately; the charge for ordering clothes hangers is not rent.

lines.zh: 袋子被雨弄湿了；口语里也有人说叫雨弄湿了、让雨弄湿了。
lines.py: dài zi bèi yǔ nòng shī le ; kǒu yǔ lǐ yě yǒu rén shuō jiào yǔ nòng shī le , ràng yǔ nòng shī le .
lines.en: The bag was made wet by rain; colloquially some also use 叫 or 让 to introduce rain as the cause.

lines.zh: 绳子很紧，要先解开，不能只看袋子就说被子也湿了。
lines.py: shéng zi hěn jǐn , yào xiān jiě kāi , bù néng zhǐ kàn dài zi jiù shuō bèi zi yě shī le .
lines.en: The cord is tight and needs untying first; seeing the bag alone does not establish that the quilt is wet too.

lines.zh: 书放到书架上，旧上衣先从沙发上拿下来。
lines.py: shū fàng dào shū jià shàng , jiù shàng yī xiān cóng shā fā shàng ná xià lái .
lines.en: Put the book on the bookcase and take the used top off the sofa first.

lines.zh: 衬衫和衬衣挂好，裙子跟裤子放在两个袋子里。
lines.py: chèn shān hé chèn yī guà hǎo , qún zi gēn kù zi fàng zài liǎng gè dài zi lǐ .
lines.en: Hang up the shirts and put the skirt and trousers in separate bags.

lines.zh: 这张卡写着皮，皮包还没找到，不要把布袋当皮包。
lines.py: zhè zhāng kǎ xiě zhe pí , pí bāo hái méi zhǎo dào , bú yào bǎ bù dài dāng pí bāo .
lines.en: The card says leather; the leather bag has not been found, so do not mistake the cloth bag for it.

lines.zh: 把物品交给收件人以前，先问清楚，不替别人签收。
lines.py: bǎ wù pǐn jiāo gěi shōu jiàn rén yǐ qián , xiān wèn qīng chǔ , bù tì bié ren qiān shōu .
lines.en: Clarify before handing items to the recipient; do not sign for someone else without asking.
